policy: Only entries marked manual_import or licensed_export may write the ledger. Reference and prohibited sources are documentation, never scraper targets.

sources.name: Combat Registry
sources.coverage: Official ABC record keeper; worldwide professional MMA history
sources.notes: Preferred production source. Request a documented API or recurring export from support@combatreg.com before scheduling collection.

sources.name: All Pro MMA Fights - UFC, Bellator, One
sources.license: CC0: Public Domain (as declared by dataset publisher)
sources.coverage: 10,448 UFC, Bellator, and ONE bouts through 2021-08-11
sources.notes: Bootstrap/backtest seed only. Stale, no weight class, and originally collected from Sherdog; do not treat it as a current weekly feed.

sources.name: ONE Championship athlete records
sources.license: Official terms limit site use to personal, non-commercial access
sources.coverage: Official athlete histories with mixed MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing, and grappling disciplines
sources.notes: No automated collector until ONE grants permission or offers a licensed feed; discipline filtering would be mandatory.

sources.name: Wikipedia reviewed record supplements
sources.coverage: Reviewed professional MMA record gaps for named external-only fighter profiles
sources.notes: Website result metadata only. Each row pins a source revision, preserves attribution, and is excluded from prediction-model inputs.

sources.name: Sportradar MMA API
sources.coverage: Published MMA API documentation currently identifies UFC and Dana White's Contender Series
sources.notes: Useful vendor, but its documented public MMA coverage does not solve Bellator/ONE/PFL history.

sources.name: Tapology
sources.license: Terms restrict unauthorized use and scraping/republication
sources.notes: Never scrape from this framework without written permission and a registry change.

sources.name: Sherdog
sources.license: Terms restrict automated requests and aggregation/collation
sources.notes: The Kaggle seed is a separately published CC0 artifact; this project does not scrape Sherdog.
